snippet.title: The Curtain Is Rising on the Evermelody Troupe
snippet.description:
The Curtain Is Rising on the Evermelody Troupe

🎶Echo of Wishes Music Festival
The renowned Evermelody Troupe arrives in Florawish—and unexpectedly sparks a musical craze! A romantic, elegant classical ensemble; free-spirited street performances; animals swaying to the beat... even the winds of Miraland seem to be singing along. Stylists, join us for this grand musical feast!

※After the Version 1.9 update, the exclusive quest "A Song Without End" will unlock. [The Box Theater] level will unlock when the quest reaches a certain point. The eternal song echoing through the theater stirs singers' arias, dancers' steps, and musicians' strings... and those who enter will help perform the next act.

——
The Coziest Open-World Game!
Infinity Nikki Version 1.9 "Music Season" launches globally on September 1st (UTC-7)!
#InfinityNikki
